Tenaga Nasional Bhd Unveils Smart Grid Platform to Boost Operational Efficiency

Malaysia’s largest electricity utility, Tenaga Nasional Bhd, has officially launched a next-generation smart grid platform aimed at improving network reliability and optimising energy distribution across Peninsular Malaysia. The new system, called GridPulse, was presented at a media briefing in Kuala Lumpur on Thursday, drawing attendance from government officials, industry stakeholders and local media.

The GridPulse platform integrates advanced data analytics, real-time monitoring and automated controls to enhance the resilience of the national grid. According to Tenaga Nasional Bhd’s Chief Operating Officer, Datuk Seri Amirul Rahman, the initiative represents a “significant step forward in our commitment to delivering reliable and sustainable energy to the nation.”

“With GridPulse, we are leveraging digital technology to proactively manage load distribution and respond to evolving consumer needs,” Amirul said. “This platform will enable us to reduce losses, detect faults faster and minimise downtime, ultimately benefiting millions of households and businesses.”

Industry observers have welcomed the move. Azrul Nizam, an analyst at Kuala Lumpur-based Energy Insights, said, “The adoption of smart grid technologies is a timely investment as Malaysia works towards greater grid stability and prepares for increased renewable integration.” He noted that GridPulse’s data-driven features would support Tenaga Nasional Bhd’s plans to accommodate higher levels of solar and other renewables in the coming years.

The Malaysian Electrical Workers Union also called the launch “a positive development for both employees and consumers,” citing opportunities for technical upskilling and improved service quality.

Tenaga Nasional Bhd said the GridPulse platform will be rolled out in phases, beginning with key urban centres before expanding to rural areas by 2026. The company confirmed that no changes to tariff rates or supply arrangements are planned as a result of the platform’s introduction.
